parameters.name: search_issues
parameters.description: Search issues with JQL. Parameters: jql (required), limit (optional, default 20), fields (optional: comma-separated field names as shown in Jira (e.g. Maßnahme) or *all; their values are appended per issue), caller_name (display name of the asking person; required when the JQL contains currentUser(), the tool replaces it with that accountId). Custom fields can be written by their Jira name in the JQL, e.g. "Maßnahme" = Meta, the tool maps them to cf[NNNN]. Examples: project = KAN ORDER BY created DESC, assignee = "First Last" AND status != Done.

parameters.name: create_issue
parameters.description: Create a new issue. Parameters: project (required, key like KAN), summary (required), issuetype (optional, default Task; must match a type from list_issue_types exactly, the call is refused otherwise), description, assignee (full name, email or accountId; 'me' means the asking person), priority (e.g. Highest, High, Medium, Low), labels (comma-separated), duedate (YYYY-MM-DD), parent (parent issue key; required for sub-task level types), custom_fields (JSON object; keys are field names as shown in Jira, e.g. Maßnahme, or field ids; a plain value is enough, the shape is derived from the field schema). If creation fails with a required custom field, retry with custom_fields using one of the allowed values from the error message. In description, @Vorname Nachname or [~accountId:...] becomes a real Jira mention.

To change status use transition_issue instead. In description, @Vorname Nachname or [~accountId:...] becomes a real Jira mention.
